sources.name: Ottawa Public Library
sources.notes: Drupal 7 booking site, HTML scrape only — no JSON API and BiblioCommons events is switched off. Query is filtered to 'english' to surface ESL and conversation groups rather than 639 mostly-children's programs.

sources.name: Ottawa Public Library — newcomer programs
sources.notes: Second pass over the same site for settlement and newcomer-support sessions.

sources.name: University of Ottawa International Office
sources.notes: Real feed FOUND 2026-09-10: uOttawa runs a dedicated events system 'uoCal' at uocal.uottawa.ca, and the International Office - Current Students taxonomy (term 358) has a Drupal RSS feed at /en/taxonomy/term/358/all/feed. BUT the uocal.uottawa.ca subdomain currently returns DNS SERVFAIL from uottawa.ca's own authoritative nameservers (confirmed via Google DoH: 'rcode=SERVFAIL ... At delegation uottawa.ca for uocal.uottawa.ca/a') - unresolvable for everyone right now, a broken delegation on uOttawa's side, not a feed we can't reach. The old registered URL international.uottawa.ca/en/events is also dead - that whole subdomain now 301s to a Francophonie landing page. Re-check when uoCal DNS is restored; when it resolves this is a plain RSS parse (probably reusable via a generic rss kind, or add uocal_rss).

sources.name: Carleton University International Student Services
sources.notes: Found 2026-09-09: Carleton's custom 'cu_event' post type is exposed at plain WordPress REST (/wp-json/wp/v2/cu_event), it's just not the Tribe/Events-Calendar plugin this pipeline usually looks for - a normal /wp-json/ probe would have found it (check /wp-json/wp/v2/types style endpoints for a site's own custom post types, not just tribe). The site is multisite; /go-isso/ and /isso/ both route to the same 478-event collection, scoped correctly to GO-ISSO already. ACF fields give real start/end datetimes, cost, and building+room venue - richer than most sources here.

sources.name: Algonquin College
sources.notes: The real events page isn't /events/ (that's a Future-Students recruitment page) - it's the International Education Centre's 'IEC Events Calendar', found 2026-09-09 via the Current Students page, another Springshare LibCal instance (calendar id 7448). This is the tenant that exposed the libcal date= bug (see project-his-board-generator memory) - its /ajax/calendar/list ignored monthly=true and returned 0 until the per-day call pattern was used.

sources.name: Ottawa Community Immigrant Services Organization
sources.notes: Major Ottawa settlement agency. /wp-json/tribe 404s; calendar implementation not yet identified. Re-checked 2026-09-09: the /events-calendar/ URL now silently redirects to the homepage (200, but lands on /) - the page was retired without updating the site's own 'Upcoming Events' nav link, which points at the same dead URL. No events content exists anywhere on the homepage either (just non-dated 'Update' news items). This is a content/site gap, not a feed we failed to find - there's currently nothing published to scrape.

sources.name: Catholic Centre for Immigrants Ottawa
sources.notes: Settlement and newcomer programs. No Events Calendar REST endpoint. Re-checked 2026-09-09: real newcomer content (Canadian Taxes 101, Banking System 101, Workplace Culture, Navigating Social Assistance...) but the Sept-Oct calendar currently shows zero upcoming events - only a 'Past Events' list. Platform is Elementor + JetEngine dynamic listings with auto-generated per-element hash CSS classes (elementor-element-<hash>) that regenerate whenever the page is re-saved in the editor - too fragile to build a scraper against with nothing live to validate it, revisit once they post future dates.

sources.name: World Skills Employment Centre
sources.notes: Employment services for newcomers since 1997 (job search workshops, language training, talent matching). Registered domain (worldskillsottawa.ca) is genuinely dead (DNS NXDOMAIN, confirmed 2026-09-09) - the correct domain is ottawa-worldskills.org. WordPress + The Events Calendar, confirmed live via wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events (64 total events, 22 pages).

sources.name: City of Ottawa festivals and events
sources.notes: Marquee free events entered by hand until a feed is confirmed.

sources.name: Ottawa Tourism events
sources.notes: Found 2026-09-09: real URL is /en/event-calendar (not /en/events, which redirects here anyway). Drupal Views infinite-scroll card grid, paginated ?page=N. A network call to a Cloud Run backend (mpc-prod-*.a.run.app/events) is visible but 'Resource not found' on direct access - the content is already server-rendered into the page HTML regardless, so the card grid is scraped directly instead of chasing that API further. No time-of-day or cost shown on cards - cost defaults to 'Paid' to avoid a false free-cost credit on ticketed festivals/shows (same reasoning as ticketmaster).

sources.name: Sunnyside Church (The Table)
sources.notes: Old Ottawa South church near Carleton. Runs 'The Table' - a free monthly community meal (2nd Fridays, 6-9pm per the feed). Squarespace with a CALENDAR-display events collection: /events/?format=json is current-month-only with a silently-ignored month param, so parse_sqs doesn't work - added kind `sqs_rss` 2026-09-10 which takes the item list + metadata from /events/?format=rss (spans ~6 months) and layers the current month's precise times on top from the JSON feed. `title_filter` scopes it to the meal programme - without it the church's whole worship schedule (Sunday services, breakfasts, youth group) floors at ~55 on free+central-venue alone and buries the stream.

sources.name: Trinity Anglican Ottawa - Young Adults
sources.default_venue: Trinity Anglican Church, 1230 Bank St, Ottawa
sources.notes: Church on Bank St near Billings Bridge. The young-adults programme is described on /pages/young-adults but the monthly meal isn't always posted to the public events calendar with a consistent title (the Sept 9 'Trinity Young Adults BBQ' was, retreats are, ordinary months may not be). Same Squarespace calendar-display collection as sunnyside-church - uses the `sqs_rss` kind with a `title_filter` (see that entry, added 2026-09-10); it surfaces young-adults/retreat/newcomer items as the church posts them and drops the recurring worship schedule. Contributes 0 in a month with nothing matching - that's expected, not a break.

sources.name: Volunteer Ottawa
sources.notes: Checked 2026-09-10: WordPress + Elementor + JetEngine (jet-engine/v2 REST routes only, no tribe/EM/MEC/custom event post type). The /events/ page is client-rendered with no ld+json, no datetime attributes, no server-side event markup - same fragile auto-hash-CSS-class pattern as CCI Ottawa (a documented dead end in the probe playbook). Also this is fundamentally a volunteer-opportunity matcher, not a dated-events calendar - low value even if scraped. Genuine dead end for now.

sources.name: Woodvale Pentecostal Church - New to Canada
sources.notes: Checked 2026-09-10: 'Wrap Around Support' / 'New to Canada' newcomer ministry. Site is Squarespace but its events run through a Planning Center Church Center widget (woodvale.churchcenter.com/registrations/events/3479343) - Church Center's API is CORS/WAF-gated to the church's own bundled app specifically (a confirmed hard dead end in the probe playbook, no stdlib workaround). The /events/?format=rss and ?format=json Squarespace feeds return empty (that page isn't a real events collection). Needs hand-entered dates, or wait for a route into Church Center.

sources.name: St Alban's Church - Open Table (student meals)
sources.notes: Checked 2026-09-10: the registered URL was a diocesan news article (ottawa.anglicannews.ca), not the church. Real site is stalbanschurch.ca - WordPress + Elementor but NO events plugin at all (no tribe/EM/MEC/custom post type in wp/v2, no /events or /calendar page). 'Open Table' is a free monthly meal for students and young adults held at Centre 454 on King Edward St near uOttawa (high newcomer/student value). Recurring-only, no feed anywhere - needs hand-entered dates in manual_events, or a human to watch their bulletin/socials.
